purpose: Persistir el resumen recuperable del experimento local 10x para que futuros workers no dependan del transcript de ChatGPT.
source_boundary: Recovered from project conversation outputs; model-authored timings are diagnostic only, not external wall-clock telemetry.
findings: A worker can sustain a heterogeneous local batch of roughly 2400 output words with zero external tools under this prompt.
Self-reported model timestamps are not trustworthy wall-clock telemetry and must not be used as the primary performance clock.
A model-generated replica_id collided across two distinct conversations and is not reliable execution identity.
The next worker architecture experiment should preserve external identity and measurement while increasing local work between I/O boundaries.
missing_evidence: One of ten intended replicas was not recovered as a complete final output in the project-history lookup.
Per-replica external wall-clock timestamps were not available.
